purpose: T86 funding-timing measurement on the hourly PIT pilot cohort: does distance to the next 8h funding settlement, signed settled funding, post-settlement position, or hourly-scale funding extremity predict the 4h forward mark return. Measurement only — no fitting, no trading, no profitability claims.

cohort.label: label.forward_return_bps (perp_forward_mark_return_up_25bps_4h_gross; numeric bps present on all 716 records)

arms.A1_distance_buckets: ns_until_next_funding_settlement bucketed {0-2h,2-4h,4-6h,6-8h} via floor(dist_h/2); mean/median fwd bps per bucket
arms.A2_signed_funding_x_distance: within each distance bucket, last_funding_rate >0 vs <0 (settled-positive vs settled-negative; longs-paying-crowd hypothesis)
arms.A3_post_settlement: decision_ms mod 28800000 < 7200000 (first two hourly bars after each settlement) vs all others
arms.A4_funding_extreme: trailing-90-record mid-rank pct of last_funding_rate; top quintile (pct>=0.80) vs bottom quintile (pct<=0.20)

statistics.test: Welch two-sample t, normal-approx two-sided p (same convention as financial_signal_regime_v1); min n=10 per side
caveats: 4h forward labels on 1h bars overlap ~4x -> positive autocorrelation; Welch t nominal, p-values optimistic
pilot n=716 low-power: approx 80%-power MDE ~20-25bps; nulls may be underpowered
A1 6-8h bucket and A3 post-settlement group are the same bars by construction (mod-4h-grid equivalence)
